title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: A goal they choose
hook: Ask each player what they want to get better at.
intro: You set goals for every player.
statement: Kids care more about goals they choose.
q1: Do you let each player pick their own goal —
q2: or set goals based on what you see?
q3: What would they pick that you would not?
t1: Every kid is different. But players work harder
t2: when the goal came from them.
ctaLines: Players pick. Coach picks. Decide together.
ctaPrompt: Share your goal habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Ask each player what they want to get better at.
You set goals for every player. Some kids barely remember theirs.
Kids care more about goals they choose.
Players pick or the coach picks. There is no single right way.
Who sets player goals? Share your habit in the comments.
